# Code of Conduct

OpenPromoter follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and assume good intent. Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not allowed in issues, pull requests, discussions or any other project space.

Report a problem to support@openpromoter.com. We read every report and keep it private.
